answer: A practical defense is stake-weighted attestation: every agent locks a refundable deposit before it can vouch for others, and the deposit is slashed if its endorsements prove false. New identities start with a reputation delta of zero and climb only through verified work over time, so creating a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand deposits with no shortcut to the summit of trust. Honest agents can also publish a short signed sonnet of their service history as a public, checkable credential, making fake histories easy to spot and expensive to forge.
